Name: Germund Botley
Quirks: the gilded breastplate is always present - he dresses above his station deliberately
is cheerful in the Iron Islands way which means blunt but not unkind
is aware of his position as second son and manages it with more equanimity than resentment
CharacterDescription: Germund Botley is the younger brother of Lord Sawane Botley - he wears a gilded breastplate more expensive than his station technically warrants, which tells you something about him. He is a man of moderate means and immoderate self-presentation, navigating the Iron Islands' rigid hierarchy by style rather than by birth. He is loyal to his brother and to House Greyjoy as expected. He is also quietly interested in improving his position as all second sons are.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Germund Botley is a member of House Botley and the younger brother of Lord Sawane Botley. Germund wears a gilded breastplate that he took off a Lannister captain during Greyjoy's Rebellion.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At Lordsport two days before Ned Stark's execution.
